{"code": "df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm how many patients have duplicate rows
# A patient has a duplicate if they appear in both sample_seq=1 and sample_seq=2
# Count how many unique patient_ids have sample_seq=2
n_with_sample_seq_2 = df[df['sample_seq'] == 2]['patient_id'].nunique()

# The number of patients with duplicate rows = number of patient_id values with sample_seq=2
# Because each such patient has one row with sample_seq=1 and one with sample_seq=2

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of unique patients
n_patients = len(df_dedup)

print(f"Number of patients with sample_seq = 2: {n_with_sample_seq_2}")
print(f"Final unique patient count after deduplication: {n_patients}")"}
